48200.meaning1: frequent doing; regular practice; doing a lot (of)

examples.text: tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.

48201.grammar: aor of bahulīkaroti, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: pubb'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto'va samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ, pañca dhamme bahulīkāsiṃ. katame pañca?

48202.grammar: aor of bahulīkaroti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
48202.meaning1: practised often; developed; made much (of); did a lot

examples.text: yassaṃ, bhikkhave, disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, manasi kātum'pi me esā, bhikkhave, disā na phāsu hoti, pag'eva gantuṃ! niṭṭham'ettha gacchāmi, addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu, tayo dhamme bahulīmakaṃsu.

48204.meaning1: full of plans; with many intentions; (or) much thought about; the object of many considerations
48204.commentary: (MNa) bahusaṅkappan'ti paresaṃ uppannapatthanāsaṅkappehi bahusaṅkappaṃ. itthīnañ'hi kāye purisānaṃ saṅkappā uppajjanti, tesaṃ kāye itthīnaṃ. susāne chaḍḍitakaḷevarabhūtam'pi c'etaṃ kākakulal'ādayo patthayanti'y'evā'ti bahusaṅkappo nāma hoti. (DHPa) bahusaṅkappan'ti mahājanena bahudhā saṅkappitaṃ. (THa) bahusaṅkappan'ti bālajanena abhūtaṃ āropetvā bahudhā saṅkappitabbaṃ.

examples.text: passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

48205.meaning1: almost reached; gone most of the way; (comm) after many hundreds or thousands of years
48205.commentary: (MNa) bahusampatto'ti bahūni vassasatavassasahassāni sampatto. (MNt) bahusampatto'ti vā bahuṭṭhānaṃ atikkamitvā puratthimadvāraṃ sampatto hoti.

examples.text: tassa sīghena javena dhāvato chavim'pi ḍayhati, cammam'pi ḍayhati, maṃsam'pi ḍayhati, nhārum'pi ḍayhati, aṭṭhīni'pi sampadhūpāyanti, ubbhataṃ tādisam'eva hoti. yato ca kho so, bhikkhave, bahusampatto hoti, atha taṃ dvāraṃ pidhīyati.

48206.meaning2: common to many; shared in common with many; same with many

examples.text: maṃsapes'ūpamā kāmā bahusādhāraṇ'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

48207.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of bahu

48208.commentary: (SNa) bahussutassā'ti pariyattibahussutassa paṭivedhabahussutassa ca. (ANa) bahussuto hotī'ti bahuṃ assa sutaṃ hoti, nav'aṅgaṃ satthusāsanaṃ pāḷianusandhipubb'āparavasena uggahitaṃ hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīrañ'ca paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca, dhorayhasīlaṃ vatavantam'ariyaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ sumedhaṃ, bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti, sīlavā ca, bahussuto ca, dhammakathiko ca, paris'āvacaro ca, visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.
paripāceti nāma pubbe adātu'kāmānaṃ akattu'kāmānaṃ, ayyo bhāṇako, ayyo bahussuto, ayyo sutt'antiko, ayyo vinayadharo, ayyo dhammakathiko, detha ayyassa, karotha ayyassā'ti esā paripāceti nāma.

48210.grammar: masc, derog, comp, dimin of bahussuta
48210.meaning1: great little scholar; well learned little man

examples.text: aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka
bahuvacanaggahaṇena kvaci mahantasaddassa mah'ādeso hoti. mahantañ'ca taṃ phalañ'cā'ti mahapphalaṃ, mahabbalaṃ, evaṃ mahaddhanaṃ, mahabbhaya
bahuvacanaggahaṇaṃ kim'atthaṃ? ku'icc'etassa anappatatthesu'pi kvaci kā hoti, kāpurisā.

48215.meaning1: manifold; multiple; varied; of various kinds; many ways of

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidha-anuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

48216.commentary: (DNa) bahuvividhā gihīnaṃ arahānī'ti bahū vividhāni gihīnaṃ anucchavikāni paṭilabhati.

examples.text: bahuvividhanimittalakkhaṇaññū, atinipuṇā manujā byākariṃsu, bahuvividhā gihīnaṃ arahāni, paṭilabhati daharo susu kumāro.

48217.meaning1: understanding the many different kinds of omens and auspicious marks; knowing the many various signs and characteristics
48217.meaning2: understanding the many different kinds of omens and auspicious marks

examples.text: bahuvividhanimittalakkhaṇaññū, atinipuṇā manujā byākariṃsu, bahuvividhā gihīnaṃ arahāni, paṭilabhati daharo susu kumāro.

48218.meaning1: to be felt strongly; to be experienced intensely

examples.text: no h'idaṃ, āvuso. taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā appavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

48219.meaningLit: discourse on many things to be felt

48220.meaning1: many people; many things; much; a lot
48220.commentary: (SNPa) bahūnam'idha baddhānan'ti idha bahūnaṃ khattiy'ādīnaṃ sissānaṃ. sissā hi ācariye paṭibaddhavuttittā baddhā'ti vuccanti

examples.text: taṃ buddhaṃ asitaṃ tādiṃ, akuhaṃ gaṇim'āgataṃ, bahūnam'idha baddhānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
bahūtarā pabbajitassa iriyato, bhavanti puttā vacan'ānusārino, gihissa vā pabbajitassa vā puna, taṃ lakkhaṇaṃ jāyati tadatthajotakan'ti.

48222.meaning1: extremely helpful (for); very useful (for); highly supportive (of)

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, āvuso, āyasmā mantāṇiputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bah'ūpakāro hoti. so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati, upādāya, āvuso ānanda, asmī'ti hoti, no anupādāya.

sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.
app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'ūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'ūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

48225.commentary: (SNa) bahvannapānaṃ gharam'āvasanto'ti anāthapiṇḍik'ādayo viya bahvannapāne ghare vasanto.

examples.text: vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya sammā, kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno, bahv'annapānaṃ gharam'āvasanto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū, etesu dhammesu ṭhito catūsu, dhamme ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye'ti.

so c'assa assaddho, yāvatakaṃ saddhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya. so c'assa bahv'ābādho, yāvatakaṃ appābādhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya. so c'assa saṭho māyāvī, yāvatakaṃ asaṭhena amāyāvinā pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti yathā macchānaṃ vadh'atthāya baḷisalaggaṃ āmisaṃ khipati, evaṃ tayā pasaṃsamānena ete rūpā sattānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti vadati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya. tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya.

tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… cīrakavāsikam'pi karonti, eṇeyyakam'pi karonti, baḷisamaṃsikam'pi karonti, kahāpaṇikam'pi karonti, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonti, palighaparivattikam'pi karonti

tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… cīrakavāsikam'pi karonti, eṇeyyakam'pi karonti, baḷisamaṃsikam'pi karonti, kahāpaṇikam'pi karonti, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonti, palighaparivattikam'pi karonti
āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti yathā macchānaṃ vadh'atthāya baḷisalaggaṃ āmisaṃ khipati, evaṃ tayā pasaṃsamānena ete rūpā sattānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti vadati.

48232.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in health
48232.commentary: (MNa) pabbajitvā satt'āham'eva puthujjano ahosi, aṭṭhame pana so saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇī'ti evam'assa dve kulāni ahesuṃ. tasmā bākulo'ti saṅkhaṃ agamāsī'ti. (ANa) bākulo'ti dvīsu kulesu vaḍḍhitattā evaṃladdhanāmo thero.
48232.notes: Theragāthā verses 225-227 (TH3.3, TH172) are attributed to him.

examples.text: na kho maṃ, āvuso kassapa, evaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, imehi pana te, āvuso bākula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ methuno dhammo paṭisevito'ti. evañ'ca kho maṃ, āvuso kassapa, pucchitabbaṃ, imehi pana te, āvuso bākula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbā'ti?
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yadidaṃ bākulo.

yo hi ñāṇavirahitāya saddhāya atisaddho hoti muddhappasanno, so'pi, buddho nāma sabbalok'uttaro, sabbe tassa kes'ādayo bāttiṃsa koṭṭhāsā lok'uttarā'y'evā'ti-ādinā nayena duggahitaṃ gaṇhitvā tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhati.
tatra, bhikkhave, luddā makkaṭavīthīsu lepaṃ oḍḍenti makkaṭānaṃ bādhanāya.

48245.meaning1: oppresses; torments; afflicts; injures; causes discomfort

examples.text: kadā nu maṃ tandi khudā pipāsā, vāt'ātapā kīṭasarīsapā vā, na bādhayissanti na taṃ giribbaje, atth'atthiyaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
jātassa kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa setacchattaṃ dhārayittha divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā ussāvo vā bādhayitthā'ti.
tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.

48256.commentary: (MNa) gaddhe bādhayiṃsū'ti gaddhabādhino, gaddhabādhino pubbapurisā assā'ti gaddhabādhipubbo, tassa gaddhabādhipubbassa, gijjhaghāta-kakula-ppasutassā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti

48258.meaning1: could be held; could be caught; could be captured (with)
48258.commentary: (SNa) bādhetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti yathā vinivijjhitvā na nikkhamati, evaṃ paṭibāhitabbaṃ maññeyya bandhitabbaṃ vā.

examples.text: vātaṃ vā so jālena bādhetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyya, sakamuṭṭhinā vā so gaṅgāya sotaṃ āvāretabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kumārakā antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca jetavanaṃ macchake bādhenti.

48260.synonym: ābādhati, upahanti, khanati, tāpayati, dukkhāpeti, paritāpeti, byāpajjati, byābādheti, vibādhati, hanati, hiṃsati

48268.meaning1: name of a city; modern Varanasi

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

48270.meaning2: made in or coming from Benares

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.

48272.synonym: andha, apaṇḍita, avicakkhaṇa, aviddasu, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedha, dummedhī, nippañña, bālavant, mūḷharūpa

examples.text: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati
evam'pi viggayha vivādayanti, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āhu, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.

48273.commentary: (MNa) bāle ca paṇḍite cā'ti bālā ca paṇḍitā ca.

examples.text: yo bālo maññati bālyaṃ, paṇḍito vā'pi tena so, bālo ca paṇḍitamānī, sa ve bālo'ti vuccati.
kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

48274.commentary: (ANa) bālo na thero'tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchatī'ti so na thero bālo mando'tv'eva gaṇanaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: vuddho ce'pi, brāhmaṇa, hoti āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, so ca kāme paribhuñjati kāmam'ajjhāvasati kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhati kāmavitakkehi khajjati kāmapariyesanāya ussuko. atha kho so bālo na thero'tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
asso'va jiṇṇo nibbhogo, khādanā apanīyati, bālakānaṃ pitā thero, par'āgāresu bhikkhati.
atha kho bhagavā ṭhitako'va imā gāthā bhāsitvā yena bālakaloṇakagāmo ten'upasaṅkami. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā bhagu bālakaloṇakagāme viharati.

atha kho bhagavā ṭhitako'va imā gāthā bhāsitvā yena bālakaloṇakāragāmo ten'upasaṅkami. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā bhagu bālakaloṇakāragāme viharati. addasā kho āyasmā bhagu bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.

48279.meaning1: from the village of Bālaka; living in Bālaka; (or) (comm) very foolish
48279.commentary: (MNa) bālakiniyā'ti upālissa kira bālakaloṇakāragāmo nāma atthi, tato āyaṃ gahetvā manussā āgatā, so, etha bhaṇe, amhākaṃ satthāraṃ mahānigaṇṭhaṃ passissāmā'ti tāya parisāya parivuto tattha agamāsi. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, bālakiniyā parisāyā'ti, bālakagāmavāsiniyā'ti attho… apica bālakiniyā'ti bālavatiyā bāl'ussannāyā'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahatiyā gihiparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti bālakiniyā parisāya upālipamukhāya.

48280.meaning1: foolish undertaking; stupid course; idiotic procedure

examples.text: taṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇānaṃ bālagamanam'etaṃ mūḷhagamanam'etaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

48286.meaning1: sign of a fool; indication of an idiot

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bāl'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

48287.meaning1: foolish and wise; stupid and clever

48290.commentary: (SNa) bālabalaṃ nāma aññāṇabalaṃ. taṃ yassa balaṃ, abalam'eva taṃ balan'ti āhu kathentī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: abalaṃ taṃ balaṃ āhu, yassa bālabalaṃ balaṃ, balassa dhammaguttassa, paṭivattā na vijjati.

48291.meaning1: level of the fool; realm of the idiot
48291.commentary: (MNa) kevalā paripūrā bālabhūmī'ti bālo tīṇi duccaritāni pūretvā niraye nibbattati, tattha pakk'āvasesena manussattaṃ āgato pañcasu nīcakulesu nibbattitvā puna tīṇi duccaritāni pūretvā niraye nibbattatī'ti ayaṃ sakalā paripuṇṇā bālabhūmi.

examples.text: ayaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalā paripūrā bālabhūmī'ti.

48292.commentary: (MNa) bālalakkhaṇānī'ti bālo ayan'ti etehi lakkhiyati ñāyatī'ti bālalakkhaṇāni.

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bāl'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

48293.meaning1: chattering of fools; prattling of idiots
48293.commentary: (MNa) bālalāpanan'ti mayhaṃ putto, mayhaṃ dhītā, mayhaṃ hiraññaṃ mayhaṃ suvaṇṇan'ti evaṃ bālānaṃ lāpanato bālalāpanaṃ.

examples.text: aniccā, bhikkhave, kāmā tucchā musā mosadhammā. māyākatam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bālalāpanaṃ.

48294.meaning1: chattering of fools; prattle of idiots
48294.commentary: (SNa) māy'āyaṃ bālalāpinī'ti yv'āyaṃ viññāṇakkhandho nāma, ayaṃ bālamahājanalapāpanikamāyā nāma.

examples.text: etādis'āyaṃ santāno, māy'āyaṃ bālalāpinī, vadhako esa akkhāto, sāro ettha na vijjati.
bālasaṅgatacārī hi, dīgham'addhāna socati, dukkho bālehi saṃvāso, amitten'eva sabbadā, dhīro ca sukhasaṃvāso, ñātīnaṃ'va samāgamo.
